external_research_basis.source: Geiger et al., Causal Abstraction: A Theoretical Foundation for Mechanistic Interpretability, JMLR 2025
external_research_basis.relevance: Intervention claims require an explicit mapping from low-level mechanism changes to the bounded high-level variable being tested; intervention semantics should be part of the experiment identity.

external_research_basis.source: Zhang & Nanda, Towards Best Practices of Activation Patching in Language Models: Metrics and Methods, arXiv:2309.16042
external_research_basis.relevance: Metric and intervention-method choices can materially change interpretability conclusions, supporting first-class metric/operator identity.

external_research_basis.source: Mueller et al., The Quest for the Right Mediator, Computational Linguistics 52(1), 2026
external_research_basis.relevance: Causal units/mediators and evaluation objectives should be explicit rather than inferred from generic intervention success.

external_research_basis.source: Dura et al., Mechanistic Interpretability of Chain-of-Thought Reasoning via Sequential Activation Patching, arXiv:2608.22332, 2026
external_research_basis.relevance: Distributed and overlapping mechanisms plus random/cross-question controls reinforce conservative interpretation of isolated lesion/rescue effects.

required_deltas.change: In run_matched_lesion_rescue, require rescue_condition.disabled_capability_ids to equal lesion_condition.disabled_capability_ids. Keep rescued_capability_ids as a non-empty subset so partial restoration remains representable.
required_deltas.why: The generation-1 runner matches fixture/run provenance but does not prove that RESCUE acts inside the same declared lesion universe.
required_deltas.falsifier: A rescue condition with a different disabled set must fail closed before any evaluator step.

required_deltas.change: Add explicit immutable score_metric_id/version and lesion_operator_id/rescue_operator_id fields to the comparison/experiment identity, or prove an equivalent source-hash-bound typed constant that is serialized into the comparison digest.
required_deltas.why: Cross-version comparison should not silently treat changed scoring/intervention semantics as the same experiment.
required_deltas.falsifier: Changing any metric/operator identity while preserving fixture/capability identities must change the sealed comparison identity.

required_deltas.change: Add repository tests that execute identical condition runs from fresh begin_episode boundaries in at least two order permutations and require per-condition result equality at exact identity.
required_deltas.why: Current source is structurally state-local, but the cheap falsifier protects against future module/global-cache contamination.
required_deltas.falsifier: If order changes any per-condition result digest at fixed identity, generation-2 fails.

required_deltas.change: Emit a typed interpretation field derived only from measured deltas, with conservative vocabulary: TESTED_INTERVENTION_DEPENDENCE, TARGET_SPECIFIC_RESTORATION_AT_SCOPE, REDUNDANCY_OR_INTERACTION_UNKNOWN, or NO_RESTORATION_AT_SCOPE. Never emit NECESSARY, SUFFICIENT, UNIQUE_CAUSE or global cognitive-causality labels.
required_deltas.why: Generation-1 has a strong negative authority disclaimer but leaves positive result wording to downstream prose.
required_deltas.falsifier: A zero/small lesion effect must not be encoded as IRRELEVANT; a rescue that improves outcome without matching the paired target universe must not be labeled target-specific restoration.

explicit_non_goals: no new runtime provider or tool invocation
no requirement to add new SHAM/WRONG_RESCUE condition kinds if equivalent negative controls can be expressed with existing typed conditions
